name: RejectOrder
description: Reject, decline, or cancel a sales order in the SAP ERP system with a mandatory reason code. Trigger this function when the user requests to reject, deny, or cancel an order AND provides a clear reason. DO NOT call this function if either order_id OR reason_code is missing or not specified — NEVER guess reason_code, not even 'OTHER'.

order_id.description: The unique sales order identifier in SAP (e.g., '5', '8' or '0000005001') to be rejected. Must be explicitly stated by the user.

reason_code.description: The reason for rejection. Allowed values ONLY: 'PRICE_ISSUE' (sai giá / pricing discrepancy), 'OUT_OF_STOCK' (hết hàng / item unavailable), 'OTHER' (lý do khác / other reason). NEVER infer or guess — the reason must be explicitly stated or clearly implied by the user.
